findings.title: Where the error lives
findings.read: Volume is the larger source of error (51.9 yds from volume vs 45.5 from rate). Fix the volume model first; tuning the other half cannot recover this.

findings.title: Volume bias
findings.read: We under-project attempts by 0.01 per player (projected 31.78, actual 31.79).

findings.title: Rate bias
findings.read: yards per attempt is over-projected by 0.02 (projected 7.19, actual 7.17).

findings.title: Opponent adjustment is costing accuracy
findings.read: Error with the adjustment 62.52, without it 61.55. Removing it would be more accurate on this sample.

findings.title: Against the closing line
findings.read: Beat the line on 107/273 (39.19%). Our MAE 61.87 vs the line's 56.7. The book is the better projection.
